observation_summary: The application throws a ConcurrentModificationException when performing element-wise multiplication or division on an OpenMapRealVector.
reasoning_summary: The code was attempting to iterate over the internal map of a newly created vector ('res') while simultaneously modifying that same vector using 'res.setEntry()'. Because the iterator was initialized on the 'res' object, the 'setEntry' calls triggered a ConcurrentModificationException within the 'OpenIntToDoubleHashMap' iterator. The fix involved changing the iterator to operate on the original vector ('entries') instead of the result vector ('res'), thereby avoiding modification of the collection currently being traversed.
